paragraph: A venture capitalist named Eric Bahn took his son to a Pokémon convention in San Francisco on August 29th. The boy traded his most valuable cards with an adult and lost them to a scam. Other fans at the event heard what happened. They gathered their own cards and gave them to the child to replace what he had lost. The father watched strangers return something his son thought was gone. A convention floor became a place where people chose care over collecting.
